info.title: The Devil Lady
info.synopsis: Devil Lady' è una serie TV del 1998 ispirata al Devil Man di Go Nagai. L’eroina di turno è Jun Fudo, una modella famosa, divenuta suo malgrado una Devilman che combatte i Beast (esseri mutanti che perdono totalmente la razionalità umana) per difendere le sorti dell’umanità.

episodes.title: Belva
episodes.synopsis: Jun just seems to be going through the motions in her photo shoot, although the photographer seems to think she is doing wonderfully. Jun seems to be having a problem with mirrors and reflections today, even when they are behind curtains. Jun meets Lan Asuka, a mysterious woman, who introduces Jun to the supernatural in an overwhelming way. Kazumi is Jun's tie to normalcy. Will Jun be able to hang on after being introduced to the beast?

episodes.title: Sangue
episodes.synopsis: The battle continues. Jun is called upon to handle more than she ever imagined. She exhibits abilities that were unimagined by the Human Alliance (HA), to meet an unexpected challenge. Jun still can't believe what is happening and wonders if it was all a nightmare.

episodes.title: Ali
episodes.synopsis: Jun begins to make enemies. Those that would destroy humankind make it clear that Jun and her loved ones are fair game in the war. They cannot understand why she holds onto her inferior human side. Catastrophe strikes someone close to Jun. Jun continues to find new abilities to the surprise of her enemies and the HA.

episodes.title: Embrione
episodes.synopsis:
Jun is still reeling from previous incidents, and reflects on how she was different from others. She falls into self-pity, as she is seemingly being held captive by the H A, the very organization that utilizes her to destroy other beasts. Jun is leery of people in shadows, thanks to her last encounter.

A new beast with an unusual characteristic is discovered. This new characteristic doesn't make it any less dangerous. Asuka discovers a new power of Jun's.

episodes.title: Squalo
episodes.synopsis:
Thanks to Asuka, Jun has an unplanned reunion with an old friend from high school where they didn't part in a friendly manner. Jun and her ex-classmate had a difference of opinion on what the relationship should be. It seems that all anger has dissipated, but has it?

Meanwhile Kazumi feels a little left out. But there is no need to worry. Jun's encounter strengthens the bond to Kazumi.

episodes.title: Gatto
episodes.synopsis: Jun experiences a love / hate relationship first-hand, when she meets someone who idolizes her and loves cats. What do you do when you are so talented that you inspire love and hate? You face it head on! Is Jun up to the task?

episodes.title: Nebbia
episodes.synopsis: With each transformation, the risk increases that Jun will lose her human side. Is it possible that the childhood story of the Grim Reaper will be Jun's undoing? Recent events take Jun's thoughts back to the story her grandfather told her hoping she would go to bed. Of course Jun's curiosity was only increased. Is her next foe The Grim Reaper?

episodes.title: Nemico
episodes.synopsis: The HA continues their attempt to keep the general population from discovering the devil beast phenomenon. A broadcaster attempts to release the news of the devil beasts. Jun is introduced to Dr Jason Bates, an American from the Samuelson Lab. Jason has come to observe the giga effect, which transforms the devil beasts into giants. He doesn't believe that beasts are inherently evil and that devil beasts can hold on to their human soul. Jun's confrontation with the broadcaster doesn't go as planned causing Dr Bates to doubt Jun's strength. Asuka feels humiliated and berates Jun.

episodes.title: Occhi
episodes.synopsis:
Jun dwells upon her previous failure and the disappointments of Asuka and Jason. While looking into a store window, Jun feels someone watching her. Jun finds herself in the park in a photo shoot.

Kazumi is interviewed and photographed. She also meets someone who has an interest in what happened to her family.

Those around Jun begin to question her sanity when she seems to continually feel watched. Is she being watched, or is it just her imagination?

episodes.title: Fuoco
episodes.synopsis:
A large fire at the Sakura Housing Complex looks suspicious. Firemen are surprised to find a a survivor in the rubble. Asuka and Jun disagree on how the small survivor should be treated. Asuka believes the survivor to be a devil beast, since survival would have been impossible otherwise. The fact of the HA having no experience with a devil beast being a child doesn't temper Asuka's belief. The Biochemical Investigations Team decides to study the child.

Kazumi reviews a videotape that was sent by Sakazawa. Remembering his earlier comment she wonders about Jun. Jun's frequent and sudden departures don't help Kazumi's confidence in their relationship.

episodes.title: La scatola
episodes.synopsis: A department store executive disappears after being falsely accused. Unfortunately, he isn't the only one who disappears. Jun is called in to handle this situation in an all too public department store building, all just in time for Christmas. Jun discovers his box as well as her own…

episodes.title: Volti
episodes.synopsis:
Jun has visions of a devil beast world. Does her demonic side want such a world? Yuasa offers to lighten Jun's workload. When Jun runs into Jason in the street, they go to a cavern bar.

Jason accuses Jun of enjoying the kill, and yet calls her weak mentally and physically. Maeda tells Jun that she will need to accompany him as soon as she gets home. The authorities are finding victims with their face missing. Meanwhile, Jason still obsesses over Jun's and some of the other beasts' ability to manifest the giga effect. Asuka's orders reflect her belief that beasts in the giga effect are no longer in control, endangering Jun's life.

episodes.title: Corda
episodes.synopsis:
A man is restrained in a remote residence. A woman entices him.

Jun has a photo shoot with inexperienced model Takai, a high school student that is more intimate than usual. Jun shows interest in a phone call that Yuasa receives during the photo shoot. After the photo shoot Jun acts inappropriately with Takai and shows regret.

Jun sees Sakazawa speaking to Kazumi and Yuasa in separate incidences. She concludes the man is a nuisance.

Asuka picks up Jun and tells her they are going for a ride in the country. She tells Jun they have found a victim with one-third of the blood drained from the body. Will Jun fall into the trap found by this young victim?

episodes.title: Casa
episodes.synopsis: Sakazawa remembers his life before the beast obsession. All devil beasts are alike aren't they? Will Sakazawa always believe this? Kazumi is missing and Jun will do what it takes to find her. Meanwhile, Kazumi realizes she has been used, but isn't quite sure for what. The HA has their hands full with another beast, and receives unexpected help. The battle between the beast factions now begins to accelerate.

episodes.title: Corvo
episodes.synopsis: Kazumi's conversation after a photo shoot, plants the seeds of remembrance regarding her parents death. Bodies begin to show up on top of lamp posts, utility poles and other odd places. Shiro Kazawa's warnings replay through Kazumi's mind. Crows show up in the oddest places. The HA thinks Jun needs a chauffeur. Kazumi once again becomes noticed by the beasts. Jun continues to amaze those who witness her power, but will it be enough to save Kazumi?

episodes.title: La voce
episodes.synopsis: The dead bodies on top of traffic posts continue. The HA begins to have trouble keeping the secret of the devil beasts. Maeda gets directly involved in the fight against devil beasts. Kazumi's voice is a God-send to Jun.

episodes.title: Fame
episodes.synopsis: Saturo continues to recruit beasts to his cause. His statement that Jun is hated by the humans seems to be manifesting itself. Jun appears to be losing control of her beast side. Where is Asuka?

episodes.title: Corpo
episodes.synopsis: The battle between humans and devil beasts is worsening. Jun is surprised by Asuka and Jason. Can Jason keep his human side if he gets his wish? Asuka's behavior is drawing the attention of the HA.

episodes.title: Catene
episodes.synopsis: Kazumi is still getting used to the idea of the beasts in the open. Can she learn to trust any devil beast other than Jun? Yuasa is surprised to see Maeda after their last conversation. Maeda becomes more suspicious of Asuka. Jun continues to be a fugitive. The battle with the beast is no longer a secret. Yuasa and Jun temporarily relive a normal work day. Yuasa's family has a stressful day, while he lives in a fanciful moment.

episodes.title: Cadaveri
episodes.synopsis: This episode goes to America. This episode Lan gets a new private secretary, Captain Izume Kogure. Maeda gets some American help. Jun meets some old acquaintances that she's not particularly wanting to see. Jun meets a new more powerful associate of Satoro's. Maeda discovers Lan's secret past. Jun and Satoro have a battle of the wills.

episodes.title: Segno
episodes.synopsis: What is this RNA Transmutation Innoculation? Maeda discovers the truth and informs Jun. Kazumi becomes closer to her new friends, but still wants to be with Jun. Will they be reunited? Will Jun be able to overcome the organized beasts?

episodes.title: Desiderio
episodes.synopsis: Jun receives help from an unexpected source, when defeat is imminent. Will it be enough? Kazumi remembers her first meeting with Jun. Hostility increases between humans and the devil beasts. Devil beasts are rounded up as Satoro gathers his army. Izumi is concerned about Lan Asuka. Jun inspires a fond childhood memory in Kazumi. Kazumi wants to help Jun in a new way. Will she get her wish?

episodes.title: Vita
episodes.synopsis: Jun is legendary among the gentler beasts as the champion of their kind. Kazumi's influence inspires hope in her recently found friends. They expect Jun to rescue them. Lan's plan becomes more apparent. Jun faces a beast with unexpected strength. Lan is still involved with the US, but why? What is her relationship to Jun?

episodes.title: Anima
episodes.synopsis: Home is where the heart is. Jun befriends a new young companion who understands Jun's past too well. Unfortunately Chiyoko doesn't understand why Jun had to do all that she did. She doesn't understand the fine line that Jun mustn't cross.

episodes.title: Dio
episodes.synopsis: Beasts are kept like prisoners. Asuka can't wait for Jun's return. Kiyoko, Misaki, Takae and Takeshi try to avoid extermination in the beast prison. Asuka sends a not so friendly welcoming party when Jun returns to Tokyo. What is the relationship between Jun and Asuka?

episodes.title: Uomo
episodes.synopsis: Asuka has appeared all over the world and is forcing the world to accept her as the new child of God. Jun awakes in a place like hell and sees all of the demons trapped in a tower forged of demon bodies. Jun decides to forge her soul with the force from the Demons leaving the hell like place to face off with Asuka. A battle of Heaven and Hell begins, but who will be victorious?

info.title: Cultural Exchange With a Game Centre Girl
info.synopsis: Renji Kusakabe è un giovane che lavora part-time presso una sala giochi. Un giorno finisce per conoscere casualmente Lily, una ragazza inglese con cui decide di scrivere dei diari per conoscere reciprocamente le proprie culture. Renji rimane influenzato dall'innocenza di Lily, ma questo scambio interculturale è solamente amicizia oppure...

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: While working at an arcade, Renji strikes up a friendship with an English girl who can't speak Japanese.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Renji's sister Aoi asks him to make her a "game center pro" before she visits the arcade with her friend Lily.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: After Renji and Lily go on their date, Aoi informs Renji that she invited Lily to come over for a study party.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Lily's jealousy is ignited when a pretty girl who visits the arcade turns out to be Renji's college classmate.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: When Lily forces Renji to walk her home on a rainy day, the two happen to run into Lily's intimidating father.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: A new challenger shows up at the game center to compete for Renji's attention, but Lily steps in to stop her.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Hotaru checks whether her classmates are engaging in meaningful activities in the arcade.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Lily invites her school friends and Renji to her birthday party and shows them how people celebrate in the UK.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: As Lily and friends enjoy their summer vacation, new and unique guests start to appear at Renji's game center.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The game center holds an Otokogi Koala Fighters knockout tournament that attracts a wide variety of players.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Lily, Karin, and Hotaru join Renji and Aoi on a trip to visit their grandma's home up north in rural Tohoku.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: With Grandma's love story still fresh in their minds, Lily and Renji face up to their feelings for each other.

info.title: Falco il superbolide (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il diciottenne Ken Hayabusa è un pilota da corsa molto abile, affilliato alla scuderia Sayongi e alla guida dell'Hayabusa Special, macchina da corsa costruita dal suo stesso padre. Il principale rivale della Sayongi e di Ken è la squadra Black Shadow, capitanata dal misterioso Ayab Moby Dick e nota per la sua grande scorrettezza. I piloti della Black Shadow sono infatti disposti a fare di tutto, commettendo qualsiasi infrazione al regolamento, non importa quanto pericolosa, per eliminare Ken Hayabusa e gli altri piloti della Sayongi.

episodes.title: Arriva il campione
episodes.synopsis: I piloti appartenenti alle scuderie di tutto il mondo si sfidano in una corsa mortale sul monte Aso, un vulcano ancora attivo. Qui fà la sua comparsa una squadra giapponese ancora sconosciuta, la Saionji Racing, che a sorpresa di tutti batte l'invincibile e spietata Black Shadow. Le due scuderie s'affrontano nuovamente nel deserto australiano, in una corsa entusiasmante, ricca di suspense e di pericoli.

episodes.title: Corsa sulle Alpi
episodes.synopsis: Persa la precedente corsa sul monte Aso, Ayab Mobil Dick vuole sconfiggere a tutti i costi la scuderia Saionji Racing. Per questo, organizza una corsa in salita sulle Alpi e fa costruire un percorso speciale sulla vetta del monte Bianco. Nessuno immagina quali ostacoli e quali trappole diaboliche abbia escogitato il boss della Black Shadow.

episodes.title: Corsa nelle grotte
episodes.synopsis: Il regno di Le Mans organizza una corsa speciale per celebrare i 500 anni della sua fondazione. Per l'occasione è stata preparata una pista di 1000 chilometri in un labirinto di caverne dal quale sembra impossibile poter uscire vivi. Jack "La Spada" e gli altri piloti della Black Shadow sfidano per la terza volta la scuderia Saionji Racing, facendo uso di espedienti sempre più irregolari.

episodes.title: Il segreto del diabolico Ayab
episodes.synopsis: Dopo la cocente sconfitta inflitta dalla Saionji Racing alla Black Shadow (Le Mans), Baron (il braccio destro di Ayab Mobil Dick) ingaggia Harry Jerome detto "Hurricane Harry", scorretto campione di bob e amico di lunga data di Mutsu. Sulla scena di una distesa di ghiaccio, si svolge un'impetuosa lotta testa a testa fra le due scuderie. Ken e i suoi compagni dovranno riuscire ad evitare la mortale tecnica di Harry soprannominata "Black Killer"...

episodes.title: Il circuito della città fantasma
episodes.synopsis: Ayab, infuriato per le ripetute sconfitte, ha scelto lo scenario diAgnaria City per vincere la scuderia di Saionji ed eliminare definitivamente Ken "Il Falco" Hayabusa. Non solo lungo il percorso di gara sono state poste cariche di dinamite e varie trabocchetti, ma (pare...) che questi siano attivati casualmente da una scimmietta, tramite un telecomando che le è stato dato...

episodes.title: Black Shadow
episodes.synopsis: Thomson, known as the god of racing, was killed by Black Impulse, who drives his opponents to death through team play. When Tsurugi learns that Thomson was the one who taught his brother how to race, he decides to take revenge. Meanwhile, the cunning Baron has prepared another set of Black Impulse as his trump card. Team play has no choice but to fight with team play!

episodes.title: Il diamante nero
episodes.synopsis: Kamikaze and Gantetsu attempt a race, but not only do they run out of fuel, but their temporary gas station is blown up, leaving them stranded. Baron issues a ruthless order to kill him, but Hawk is unable to lay his hands on the sword that believed in his innocence.

episodes.title: Attenzione, Sakura!
episodes.synopsis: Sakura, who is obsessed with designing a special machine, stays up all night to complete the new machine, Sakura. As soon as the race at Dead Valley began, it was my turn. Since it was difficult to access the steep mountain course at Big Garry and all the important spots had been captured, the Sakura was assigned a major role in refueling.

episodes.title: La pista Africana
episodes.synopsis: The Saionji Racing Team, which is on a winning streak, has received an invitation to an oil race in Africa. Since the journey will be tough, crossing deserts and snowy mountains just below the equator, the doctor will conduct an endurance test using a kamikaze machine. Shocked to see his beloved car damaged and broken, Kamikaze returns to his parents' home, but is chased away by his mother who understands the situation. When he returned to the research institute, he was greeted by...

episodes.title: La gara di Tortica
episodes.synopsis: Black Shadow realized that the Hayabusa's weakness was its ability to climb hills, and created a demonic labyrinth course using the underground ruins of Tolteca. The race begins, and the swords that have undergone special training fly smoothly through the vast ruins. However, Baron uses the stone statue that is the keystone of the labyrinth to break down the structure of the ruins, leaving the course suspended in the air due to a large amount of sand!

episodes.title: La creazione della V-3
episodes.synopsis: Angered by the news of his retirement, Tsurugi takes out his frustration at the constant tests on the doctor. The doctor was developing a new V3 engine to overcome Hayabusa's weaknesses. Although the prototype was completed, the experiment failed. Tsurugi, who will be participating in a race in the Himalayas, decides to install a V3 engine on the condition that the engine speed does not increase.

episodes.title: Vittoria all'ultimo metro
episodes.synopsis: In order to defeat Hayabusa, the Demon King Ahab scouted the lone wolf and skilled racer, the Shooting Star Dragon. Ryu rides to the test course to test the enemy's ability, and takes a liking to the sword, and a strange friendship develops between the two. But a game is a game. Seeing the pebble thrown on the water surface, Ryu comes up with a special move to overcome the Hayabusa by making up for the difference in machine performance.

episodes.title: Guida su due ruote
episodes.synopsis: Tsurugi, who tasted defeat due to Ryu's triple jump running method, devised a single-wheel running method inspired by car chases. The stage for the rematch will be a race on the Iranian plateau. The fierce battle for the top between the dragon and the sword continues. Ken defeats Ryu in a battle over a rocky area, but is faced with a difficult situation due to the course's weaknesses in single-wheel running. If he makes a mistake, he will fall to the bottom of the valley, but he will take part in a high-stakes game!

episodes.title: Uno stile di guida
episodes.synopsis: A man named Will Prague sells himself to the Saionji team as a racer in search of wealth and fame. When the doctor tries to drive him back, Will points out that the reason the Gantetsu can't win is due to a problem with the driver's ability. Iwatetsu is troubled by these words, and before he knows it, he starts to lose himself. What brought him back to normal was the teachings of his father, a martial artist.

episodes.title: Amore sulle piste
episodes.synopsis: A crimson machine suddenly appeared from behind Hayabusa and overtook it in a brilliant manner. It was the legendary car, the Royal Majesty, which had gone missing. The person behind the wheel is Romy, the daughter of the late famous racer Wells. Romy, who has fought with a sword before, challenges him to a one-on-one match at Yatsugatake, hoping to settle the matter this time.

episodes.title: La corsa del safari
episodes.synopsis: Journalist Atkin, who covered Romy's death, visits the institute. He asks for your help in discovering Ahab's true identity. Rejected by the doctor, Atkin changes his face through plastic surgery and infiltrates Black Shadow, calling himself Lightning Tony. Tony approaches the sword, reveals his true identity, and proposes a match-fixing match. The sword that is troubled by troubles...

episodes.title: Il mistero di XI
episodes.synopsis: The shooting star dragon, who was defeated by the single-wheel running method, continues to train for mountain races under Professor Mephisto. Black Shadow has completed its secret weapon against Hayabusa, the quick cornering wheel. After witnessing the murder of the man who took the blueprints with him, Ryu participates in the Innsbruck race with mixed feelings. Ken also participates and takes on a battle with his archenemy.

episodes.title: Il motore V-4
episodes.synopsis: After experiencing defeat for the second time at the hands of the dragon, Tsurugi declines the invitation for a comfort trip and remains at the research institute. In order to settle the matter on equal terms with him, Ryu dares to give him the blueprint for a quick cornering wheel. The new V4 engine has already been completed and all that remains is testing. However, due to an unexpected problem, V4 becomes unusable.

episodes.title: Attacco a super Falco
episodes.synopsis: The sword was tangled up by a biker gang, and while protecting Sakura, he sustained a wound on his precious left hand. Furthermore, he is given a restraining order as punishment and is prohibited from riding a falcon. Meanwhile, Baron was scouting the Gayla brothers. They are racers who defeat their opponents with a combination unique to twins. The sword's eyesight was taken away by the powerful ultraviolet rays...

episodes.title: Shock sul circuito
episodes.synopsis: Kamikaze, who participated in the All-Japan race, tries his best to show his mother how good he is, and ends up seriously injuring the driver without noticing trouble in the car in front of him. Kamikaze is unable to drive as he would like due to the shock, but the doctor still orders him to get on the machine. Ahab is not going to miss this opportunity and requests to participate in the race on the Great Snowy Mountain.

episodes.title: La bandiera della vittoria
episodes.synopsis: To put an end to the fierce battle, Ahab takes off his armor and reveals his true identity. He then challenges the Saionji Racing Team on the condition that the loser retires from the racing world. In order to defeat Ahab, the Doctor installs a V5 engine into the Hayabusa. Have everyone master the one-wheel method. And now, the battle for the future of the racing world has begun!

info.title: Marimo no Hana: Saikyou Butouha Shougakusei Densetsu
info.synopsis: Marimo una bambina tranquilla che frequenta la quarta elementare per una serie di eventi si vede costretta a diventare una forte street fighter che lotta contro i ragazzini delinquenti.

info.title: Brave Story
info.synopsis: Wataru Mitani è un normalissimo studente delle scuole medie, fino a quando la sua vita viene sconvolta da alcuni eventi: l'abbandono della famiglia da parte del padre, l'arrivo nella sua classe di un nuovo studente abilissimo in tutte le materie e gli sport, e infine la scoperta di un passaggio dimensionale tramite cui arrivare in un regno fantasy, in cui lui possiede i poteri di un viaggiatore. Nel frattempo sembra che alcuni dei mostri di questa nuova dimensione siano giunti nel nostro mondo, nonostante il sigillo della porta glielo impedisca.

episodes.title: Seven's Special Mission
episodes.synopsis: Seven embarks on a search for his long-lost memories — overcoming countless obstacles to awaken what's been sealed in the dark shadows.

episodes.title: Return to Xuanwu
episodes.synopsis: As the path to regaining his memories turns perilous, Seven faces Cheap-Life Hua — who hopes their battle will awaken his true self.

episodes.title: Acting Chairman of Chicken Island
episodes.synopsis: Redtooth ends Chicken Island's crisis and steps up as acting director — though fear from his colleagues leaves him stuck with menial work.

episodes.title: Thumbs-Up Showdown
episodes.synopsis: Consumed by vengeance, Ouyang Zan challenges Seven to a duel. Yet when Seven risks his life to save bystanders, guilt takes hold of him.

episodes.title: Nine-Fingered Deadful Melody
episodes.synopsis: After his sword duel, Seven and Dai Bo take refuge at an inn — where an encounter with the Nine-Fingered Deadful Melody helps them escape danger.

episodes.title: Bravely Barging Into Plum Blossom Mountain Villa
episodes.synopsis: With the Nine-Fingered Deadful Melody's help, Seven arrives at Plum Blossom Mountain Villa — uncovering echoes of a battle fought there days earlier.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.synopsis: At Plum Blossom Mountain Villa, Seven meets Plum Blossom Thirteen, who asks to be trained — but their lesson is interrupted by looming threats.

episodes.title: Prison Break
episodes.synopsis: Imprisoned with He DaChun, Seven tries to escape using the Thousand Demon Daggers — only to be recognized by an old enemy eager for rematch.

episodes.title: Eyeless Master's Prophecy
episodes.synopsis: At a graveyard from his memories, Seven learns the shocking truth about his past from the Eyeless Sorcerer — but fate takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: Battle of Black Rock Mountain
episodes.synopsis: Risking danger, Seven disguises himself as Plum Blossom Thirteen to rescue her master — walking into a fight that'll test his resolve.

info.title: Undead Unluck: Winter Arc
info.synopsis: Billy tradisce l'Unione e si impossessa della Tavola Rotonda. In mezzo a una tempesta di neve causata da UMA Winter, riceve un rapporto sulla battaglia di Autumn e scopre che Undead e Unluck si stanno evolvendo. Juiz appare, rivelandogli che gli artefatti sono armi destinate a sconfiggere Dio e che l'Arca può eseguire solo un altro loop. Lo esorta a unire nuovamente le forze e a puntare tutto su Unluck per raggiungere il loro obiettivo comune: "sconfiggere Dio". Tuttavia, Billy dichiara che non possono lavorare insieme. Juiz capisce la vera intenzione di Billy ottenere l'Arca e l'Apocalisse ma prima che possa agire, Billy li trascina in uno scontro brutale che coinvolge gli UMA di entrambe le parti.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Billy tradisce l'Unione e si impossessa della Tavola Rotonda. In mezzo a una tempesta di neve causata da UMA Winter, riceve un rapporto sulla battaglia di Autumn e scopre che Undead e Unluck si stanno evolvendo. Juiz appare, rivelandogli che gli artefatti sono armi destinate a sconfiggere Dio e che l'Arca può eseguire solo un altro loop. Lo esorta a unire nuovamente le forze e a puntare tutto su Unluck per raggiungere il loro obiettivo comune: "sconfiggere Dio". Tuttavia, Billy dichiara che non possono lavorare insieme. Juiz capisce la vera intenzione di Billy ottenere l'Arca e l'Apocalisse ma prima che possa agire, Billy li trascina in uno scontro brutale che coinvolge gli UMA di entrambe le parti.

info.title: Super Heavy God Gravion Zwei
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Super Heavy God Gravion

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis:
The Gravion team completes another mission, mucht to the delight of the president. Someone says the Zerevie are going to return at any moment. The team is made to be maids, due to a strip mah jongg game that got out of control. They are forced to cook, clean, do the laundry, repair robots, and more. Eiji is forced to wear a dress.

Meanwhile, Mr. Sandman is meeting with someone elsewhere. Back at the mansion, Luna shows off Toga's room when he was a child to Eiji. Then the G-alert sounds. The Grand Knights go to intercept the intruder. After much destruction, they decide to combine, but cannot. He's stuck in a subway. After trashing a street punk, Sandman shows up and lets them combine into Gravion. A lot of chaos and distruction ensues, ending with the Zerieve being destroyed.

Elsewhere, some generic sinister people are plotting to reshape the earth...

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The gang surfs the interenet and visits Gravion's web site. Every page is "under construction" except for a headquarters map, which looks like a 3-year-old drew it. The maids blame Eiji.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: It's generic trip-to-the-hot-springs episode! Raven and Cookie have stayed behind though. At the springs, fanboy service comes fast and furious. Ena is a bit shy, but her towel is taken away anyway. Eiji relaxes in the men's bath when some of the maids enter. In escaping them, he falls over a cliff with only a section of fence to protect him. He ends up turning it into a tobogan. He crashes through the women's bath. Toga joins Eiji, thinking this is a fun game. They end up crashing at the bottom, where Toga ends up on top of G-Force's commander. After getting smacked by her, Toga spies Sandman talking to a man.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis:
At the EFA's underwater energy base, something is attacking it. They ask Gravion to investigate. Leele goes there, and they lose contact with her. The others investigate. Eiji takes Una's place. The Zerivire attacks at this point. Toga finds Leele and rescues her, only to be confronted by some mini-Zerivire. Toga forces Leele into another room while he battles the Zerivire alone. Meanwhile, just as things were looking hopless outside, the rest of the Gravion arrives. Eiji finds Toga lying on the ground, with his head in Leele's lap.

After the rescue, Gravion is formed and then attacks the Zerivire. Toga has lost his sight due to lack of oxygen. However, Leele goes to him and guides his hands.

Later on, Toga recovers at the base.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: The gravion gang goes to an amusement park Grand Island with some of the maids. There's a Zerivire there. Back at the base, the maids protest to Raven that they want to go to the park too. Back at the park, they can't find anything wrong initially. Leele laments that she doesn't have any memory of her past; the others tell her that she can simply make some by being with them. Leele and Toga are in a skyride by themselves, and Leele makes a move on Toga.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Elji and the others suspect that Sandman is hiding something connected to the frequent Zelabaia attacks, and they sneak into the north tower of St. Germain Castle. There they discover the Sandman's mysterious past and the secrets behind the creation Gravion. Some of the mysteries behind Leele's birth are also unveiled, and when Toga tells her about it, she is so shocked that she throws herself into the Lake.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The Earthgultz members are worried about Leele. Toga in particular is berating himself becuase he always seems to hurt the people around him through his own carelessness and inability to understand their feelings. Zelabaia attacks while Toga is still upset, and his agitation keeps Gravion from functioning properly, making it flounder in battle.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Sandman is keeping vigil on his daughter when the news comes: Toga's gone missing. Hugi has been watching this all this time, and gloats over this. It's going his way now. Eiji goes out after him.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Leele finally awakens from her coma. Eiji's out looking for Toga. Faye takes Toga to the orphanage where they grew up. It was sponsored by Sandman. She tells him that she resents him for taking her position as the Gravion's pilot. Faye tries to recruit Toga into the Grand Troopers. Just as he's about to give into her, Eiji arrives.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: There's a new Gravion called sol Gravion. Zieg recognizes its power source as a device that decimated an alien race. It turns out the main pilot of the Sol Gravion is Ena. Ena tells us she's a clone of the original that died, but has all the memories of the original. The Zerivire apparently leave (yet another unexplained plot hole.) The Gravion team takes the Sol Gravion for a test spin. Sandman tells us that the Sol Gravion has the power to destroy the world - or create a new one. Eiji and Toga make up for their fight. Sandman frees Eiji, saying he has no obligations to Sandman anymore.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The Gran Knights and the rest of the castle take to space in order to take the battle to the Zeravire homeworld. It is the beginning of the final battle, where the fate of the universe will be decided.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: This is it, The final battle for the fate of the universe has begun as the Gran Knights and Sandman take on Hugi and the ulitmate Zeravire weapon. As the whole world looks on, our heroes must band together like never before to ensure the saftey of mankind. Win or lose, it is time for the end and time for goodbyes.

info.title: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt
info.synopsis: Sakuradaimon è un prefetto della scuola e come tale è autorizzato a far rispettare la disciplina. Come prefetto dovrebbe essere un modello per gli altri studenti, ma sfortunatamente è tutt'altro che perfetto. Kohinata è una delle studentesse che viene constantemente ripresa per il suo abbigliamento non in linea con il regolamento scolastico, ma per ora ha ignorato i tentativi del ragazzo di disciplinarla. Questa è la storia di due persone completamente opposte che iniziano ad interagire tra di loro.
